Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.22.0 enables the local driver on host or ordinary client for ATV, two-seat speedboat, off-road car, airship, train, carriage and T-34 by using SCNET's native mounted-parent BodyUpdate synchronization. Two-seat vehicles keep the assigned driver as the first child body so passengers cannot take movement authority. Tank turret state is replicated separately and remote fire is server-validated; explosive projectiles are never created by ordinary clients. Existing crops, ecology, creatures, furniture and vehicle resources remain included. Android/7723 multiplayer behavior is pending real-device verification.
Author: SCIE-Port contributors; upstream authors credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
